name: draft-channel-preset
description: Turns a sentence about a kind of channel (a help desk, a tracker) into its purpose, rules and settings, shown before anything is applied.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: One line under the channel's name: what it is for

fields.description: How the channel is used, a few short sentences
